items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: Everybody out of Cab's band went over to hear Duke and then night I sit in with Duke's band which was about the last set, and that's my only time ever playing with Duke.

ctx.x: No, I never had the pleasure, one time had the pleasure of sitting in with Duke's band, that was in

Chicago; we was playing the Regal Theatre and I think they were playing the Audubon Ballroom right next to the Regal or something, and we had finished the theatre, which is about 11:00, 11:30, well next door with them playing a dance, they had to play until about 1, 1:30. Everybody out of Cab's band went over to hear Duke and then night I sit in with Duke's band which was about the last set, and that's my only time ever playing with Duke.
That's when Sonny Greer was still--
